'''Nectar''' was a substance found in certain plants such as the [[M'iiyoom]] plant. Small animals like [[Insect/Legends|insects]] and [[Rodent/Legends|rodents]] would try to feed on nectar, only to be devoured.<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref>
